global_fail_closed_checks: record exact URL/path and SHA-256 or Git blob identity
reject missing, duplicate, ambiguous, stale or non-finite evidence
write deterministic blocked status and zero business rows on failure
add positive, negative, boundary and stale-retry fixtures
propagate verified lineage into candidate, web and final receipts
controls: Catalogue publication date, represented data month and retrieval timestamp must be separate and bound.
Each authority URL must equal the current catalogue href, not merely an old seed URL.
Members colliding after basename, Unicode normalisation or case-folding must block extraction.
Encrypted, CRC-failing or excessive compression-ratio members must block.
Selected layer must prove the expected INSPIRE cadastral schema/namespace.
Feature must bind authority, archive SHA, member SHA, layer and feature identity.
DescribeCoverage axis labels must be advertised; silent E,N fallback is forbidden.
Axis names/order must be resolved to easting/northing before WCS subsets.
GeoTIFF bounds must fully cover the exact polygon and requested padding.
Transform must be north-up and axis-aligned; rotation/shear requires reconciliation.
Returned resolution must remain within documented tolerance of nominal 1 m.
Raw extrema must retain band,row,column and BNG pixel-centre coordinates bound to GeoTIFF SHA.
OWS/XML exceptions must be detected across the full bounded response, not only the first 512 bytes.
Only official .asc members may satisfy the numeric grid gate; generic .txt is forbidden.
Header must declare ncols=200, nrows=200 and cellsize=50.
xllcorner/yllcorner must align with the exact 10 km tile southwest origin.
Header NODATA, raster nodata and mask must agree before statistics.
Outer/nested archives must reject encrypted, CRC-failing and excessive-ratio members.
Resolver success requires every exact required 10 km tile, not any ASCII member.
GML external data reference must point to and SHA-bind the sampled ASC.
Per-tile metadata reference must equal selected tile and member names.
PRJ, GML and metadata CRS/vertical-reference declarations must agree.
Candidate payload/rows must bind continuation_key and exact parcel IDs.
Manifest must bind accepted schema/revision/task safety fields and reject unsafe flags.
Explicitly invalid port-8012 base must block instead of silently falling back.
Loopback requests must disable environment proxies and prove direct local transport.
Every operation document must bind slot/task/attempt/continuation and declared count.
Every source/example document must bind identity and declared counts.
Candidate file must resolve inside current-run output root without symlink/reparse escape.
Visible targets must bind row, parcel_id, HMLR ID, metric and confidence together.
Only one guarded recovery may run; lock ownership and run_id must be receipted.
origin URL must be pinned to the canonical repository before fetch/sync.
Timeout must terminate the helper process tree and prove no orphan runner remains.
Every early exception/exit must atomically publish 015/016 with continuation and revision.
Process enumeration failure blocks; mutex, pinned launcher, exact-one process and fresh heartbeat are required.
Verifier must pin extractor/HMLR/EA chain, run behavioural fixtures and distinguish static PASS from executed recovery.
